name: Albric recruits Candure and Eivlyn
description: Passing through Godrastan, Albric sees Candure perform magic and takes her and her brother into the Order, saving them from exposure under its naturalist laws.

name: Leaving Hearth
description: Adventure #1 begins: in spring, the cell sets out from Hearth to seek the tomb of Incentus I.

name: A jackdaw returns a note
description: Watch at H-1:a-1, fair weather; all travel. A passing jackdaw drops [[document/orders-note|a note from the Order]] for [[Albric van Lahlen|Albric]].

name: Distant thunder
description: Watch at H-1:b-1, mild and sunny; all travel. In the distance, snarling thunder ranges beneath a furrowed nimbus of black.

name: Camp outside Mouldy Manor
description: POI 1. The cell makes camp; all consume a ration.

name: The messenger's remains
description: Gathering wood in the brush, Eivlyn finds a body in barely extant guardsman's leathers. In the rotted pack, a protected leather pouch holds [[relic/the-hand-candle|a candle in the shape of a hand]], with an inscription on its base.
